{{Quote|It is better to stay quiet and protect yourself than die as a dissident.|Diblen Harleys's father to his son|<ref name="The Thrawn Trilogy Sourcebook">''[[The Thrawn Trilogy Sourcebook]]''</ref>}}
The '''father''' of [[Diblen Harleys]] was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who lived on the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] during the early [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. He served as an Imperial [[Bureaucrat/Legends|bureaucrat]]. Following the [[Death/Legends|death]] of his [[Diblen Harleys's mother|wife]], he revealed the true nature of the Empire to his son, telling him it was better to remain quiet than die as a dissenter.
